title: Fail explicitly at documented capacity while quota policy is unresolved
description:
As an operator, I want capacity and product quota limits to be explicit.

Feature: Fail explicitly at documented capacity while quota policy is unresolved
  Scenario: Observable acceptance
    Given documented local capacity limits and no approved strict cross-account quota protocol
    When an operation would exceed capacity or product quota policy is requested
    Then capacity fails explicitly and the unresolved quota and audit-rollover decisions remain visible

Planning only. No new implementation, deployment, paid call or permission is authorized by this record.
